defmodule FirmwareDevice.MessageParser do
  @moduledoc """
  Parses incoming MQTT messages for IoT device firmware.
  Handles device telemetry, commands, and OTA update notifications.
  """

  require Logger

  @max_message_size 4096
  @shutdown_timeout 5000

  defstruct [:device_id, :topic, :payload, :timestamp, :validated]

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    Process.flag(:trap_exit, true)
    schedule_heartbeat()
    {:ok, %{buffer: [], validators: build_validators(opts), pending_shutdown: false}}
  end

  def handle_info(:heartbeat, state) do
    unless state.pending_shutdown do
      flush_buffer(state.buffer)
      schedule_heartbeat()
    end
    {:noreply, %{state | buffer: []}}
  end

  def handle_info({:EXIT, _pid, reason}, state) do
    Logger.info("Received exit signal: #{inspect(reason)}, initiating graceful shutdown")
    flush_buffer(state.buffer)
    {:noreply, %{state | pending_shutdown: true}}
  end

  def terminate(_reason, state) do
    Logger.info("Shutting down message parser, flushing #{length(state.buffer)} messages")
    flush_buffer(state.buffer)
    :ok
  end

  defp schedule_heartbeat do
    Process.send_after(self(), :heartbeat, 1000)
  end

  defp flush_buffer([]), do: :ok
  defp flush_buffer(messages) do
    Enum.each(messages, &persist_message/1)
  end

  defp persist_message(msg) do
    Logger.debug("Persisting message from device #{msg.device_id}")
  end

  @doc """
  Validates and parses an incoming device message.
  Returns {:ok, parsed} or {:error, reason}.
  """
  def parse_message(raw_topic, raw_payload, validators \\ nil) do
    validators = validators || build_validators([])

    with {:ok, topic} <- validate_topic(raw_topic, validators),
         {:ok, payload} <- validate_payload(raw_payload, validators),
         {:ok, device_id} <- extract_device_id(topic, validators) do
      {:ok, %__MODULE__{
        device_id: device_id,
        topic: topic,
        payload: payload,
        timestamp: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond),
        validated: true
      }}
    end
  end

  defp validate_topic(topic, _validators) when byte_size(topic) > @max_message_size do
    {:error, :topic_too_large}
  end

  defp validate_topic(topic, validators) do
    if Regex.match?(validators.topic_pattern, topic) do
      {:ok, topic}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_topic_format}
    end
  end

  defp validate_payload(payload, _validators) when byte_size(payload) > @max_message_size do
    {:error, :payload_too_large}
  end

  defp validate_payload(payload, validators) do
    if Regex.match?(validators.payload_pattern, payload) do
      {:ok, payload}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_payload_format}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Extracts device ID from a validated topic string.
  Topic format: devices/{device_id}/telemetry/{sub_path}
  Device IDs may contain alphanumeric chars, hyphens, dots, and optional grouping.
  """
  defp extract_device_id(topic, validators) do
    case Regex.run(validators.device_id_pattern, topic) do
      [_, device_id] -> {:ok, device_id}
      _ -> {:error, :device_id_not_found}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Builds compiled regex validators. The device_id_pattern handles
  complex hierarchical device naming with optional group separators.
  """
  def build_validators(_opts) do
    %{
      topic_pattern: ~r/^devices\/[\w.\-\/]+$/,
      payload_pattern: ~r/^[\x20-\x7E\s]{0,4096}$/,
      device_id_pattern: build_device_id_regex()
    }
  end

  # Device IDs follow pattern: optional groups separated by dots,
  # each group is alphanumeric with optional hyphens.
  # Examples: "sensor-01", "floor3.wing-a.sensor-01", "a.b.c.d"
  # The regex must handle nested optional group matching for
  # firmware compatibility with legacy device naming schemes.
  defp build_device_id_regex do
    # Match hierarchical device IDs between path separators
    # Groups: (segment[-segment]*[.segment[-segment]*]*)
    Regex.compile!(
      "devices\\/(((?:[a-z0-9]+[-]*)+(?:\\.(?:[a-z0-9]+[-]*)+)*))\\/"
    )
  end
end

defmodule FirmwareDevice.OTAHandler do
  @moduledoc """
  Handles OTA firmware update messages.
  Validates update manifests before applying.
  """

  alias FirmwareDevice.MessageParser

  def process_update_notification(topic, payload) do
    case MessageParser.parse_message(topic, payload) do
      {:ok, msg} ->
        Logger.info("OTA update for device #{msg.device_id}")
        schedule_update(msg)
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.warn("Invalid OTA message: #{reason}")
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp schedule_update(msg) do
    # In production, this would queue the update
    {:ok, :scheduled, msg.device_id}
  end
end
